games.title: Sludge
games.description:
Survival island and cave exploration game with resource gathering, crafting, grid base building, and night raids.
New Update v1.1.0:
Added:
- Armor
- Sniper rifle
- Exploding barrels when shot
- Headshot multiplier (headshots now deal extra damage)
- Underground caves
- Multiple save slots for worlds
- Confirmation pop-up before deleting a world
- Island generator with random & custom seeds
- Difficulty modes & hardcore challenges (like no HP regen)
- Toggleable shaders in settings (optimized for high FPS)
- Studio splash & loading screen on game launch

Changed:
- Longer days and nights
- Darker nights for better atmosphere
- Rebalanced healing (food restores less HP, making medkits much more valuable)
- Free building — you can now build mid-air in any direction from a single foundation

Fixed:
- Beds sometimes failing to register spawn points (now works reliably)
- Enemies hitting you through walls or from mid-air
- Various player and object collision bugs
